<set-variable name="straikerUserName" value="@{
        string keysJson = (string)context.Variables["straikerClientKeysJson"];
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(keysJson) || keysJson == "{}") { return ""; }
        var xApi = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-api-key", "");
        var auth = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Authorization", "");
        string bearer = "";
        if (auth.StartsWith("Bearer ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { bearer = auth.Substring(7).Trim(); }
        try {
            var map = JObject.Parse(keysJson);
            foreach (var prop in map.Properties()) {
                var key = (string)prop.Value;
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key)) { continue; }
                bool hit = false;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(xApi)) {
                    int len = Math.Max(xApi.Length, key.Length);
                    int diff = xApi.Length ^ key.Length;
                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                        char ca = i < xApi.Length ? xApi[i] : '\0';
                        char cb = i < key.Length ? key[i] : '\0';
                        diff |= ca ^ cb;
                    }
                    hit = diff == 0;
                }
                if (!hit && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(bearer)) {
                    int len = Math.Max(bearer.Length, key.Length);
                    int diff = bearer.Length ^ key.Length;
                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                        char ca = i < bearer.Length ? bearer[i] : '\0';
                        char cb = i < key.Length ? key[i] : '\0';
                        diff |= ca ^ cb;
                    }
                    hit = diff == 0;
                }
                if (hit) { return prop.Name; }
            }
        } catch { }
        return "";
    }" />

            @{
                var xApi = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-api-key", "");
                var auth = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Authorization", "");
                var hasX = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(xApi);
                var hasB = auth.StartsWith("Bearer ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && auth.Length > 7;
                return "x-api-key=" + (hasX ? "present" : "absent") + "; bearer=" + (hasB ? "present" : "absent");
            }
